snippet.title: Agni: Village of Calamity - Official Announcement Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Agni: Village of Calamity, a third-person puzzle exploration game developed by Separuh Interactive. Players will embody Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality. Agni: Village of Calamity is coming soon to PC (Steam).
